priorities.name: Quiet, private space for calls and meetings
priorities.issue: Noise from meetings and calls on the open floor is the site's most negative theme, and phone-booth/private space is limited.
whatItLooksLike: distractions and noise level from people talking in meetings (unavoidable)
Temperature and limited number of phone booth/private workspaces

evidence.text: Noise & Distraction: 125 comments, 75% negative — the most-negative theme at the site.
Focused / Private Work is the #2 priority category (73/100); focused-work friction 28/100 (53% under-supported).

priorities.proposedAction: Assess phone-booth/private-space capacity and a call-etiquette norm against demand before adding enclosed space.
priorities.siteMustDo: Measure booth demand vs. availability, pilot a call-etiquette norm, and size any gap for Workplace Solutions.

priorities.name: Desk availability and sit/stand + workstation setup
priorities.issue: Associates want more offices and sit/stand desks, and dual monitors aren't reliably plug-and-play.
whatItLooksLike: Not enough offices, need more stand/sit desks.
Dual monitors sometimes dont work. it is not easy as plug and play. we have to spend time on it sometimes.

evidence.text: Physical Environment is the #1 priority category (75/100); Desk Availability 222 comments (50% neg).

priorities.proposedAction: Review desk mix (offices, sit/stand) against demand and standardize workstation setup with routine checks.
priorities.siteMustDo: Quantify demand for offices/sit-stand seats and fix the dual-monitor setup reliability.

priorities.name: Building operations upkeep
priorities.issue: Building-operations issues are a notable, above-norm theme even though the site is generally well-regarded.
whatItLooksLike: Building-operations items (maintenance/upkeep) recur in the comments; see the appendix.

evidence.text: Building Operations: 119 comments, 46% negative; cited at a normal-to-elevated rate.

priorities.proposedAction: Triage the recurring building-ops items and confirm a maintenance cadence.
priorities.siteMustDo: Compile the recurring maintenance items and confirm ownership/cadence with building operations.
